title: Offence - Car 63 - Unsafe release
text:
No / Driver 63 - George Russell
Competitor Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team
Session Race
Fact Unsafe release.
Offence Breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
Decision 5 second time penalty.
Reason The Stewards reviewed multiple angles of video evidence. Car 63 was released from the pit stop position into the path of NOR who had to take evasive action.

title: Infringement - Car 55 - Impeding of Car 44
text:
No / Driver 55 - Carlos Sainz
Competitor Atlassian Williams Racing
Session Qualifying
Fact Car 55 unnecessarily impeded Car 44 in turn 1.
Infringement Breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
Decision Drop of 3 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
Reason The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 55 (Carlos Sainz).

title: Infringement - Car 12 - Unsafe release
text:
No / Driver 12 - Kimi Antonelli
Competitor Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
Session Race
Fact Car 12 was released in an unsafe manner into the path of Car 43.
Infringement Breach of Article B1.6.2a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
Decision 5 second time penalty.
Reason The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 12 (Kimi Antonelli) and determined that Car 12 was released in an unsafe manner.

title: Offence - Car 44 - Pit lane speeding
text:
No / Driver 44 - Lewis Hamilton
Session Race
Fact Pit Lane Speeding – 84.5 km/h
Offence Breach of Article 34.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
Decision The competitor (Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team) is fined €500.

title: Offence - Car 5 - Pit lane speeding
text:
No / Driver 5 - Sebastian Vettel
Fact Pit Lane Speeding – 85.1 km/h
Offence Breach of Article 34.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
Decision The competitor (Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team) is fined €600.

title: Offence - Car 55 - Unsafe release
text:
No / Driver 55 - Carlos Sainz
Fact Unsafe release of car 55
Offence Breach of Article 34.14 (a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
Decision Reprimand to the driver. (Non-driving)

title: Offence - Car 31 - Unsafe release
text:
No / Driver 31 - Esteban Ocon

Offence Breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.

title: Offence - Car 1 - Collision with car 44
text:
No / Driver 1 - Max Verstappen
Fact Causing a collision
Offence Breach of Appendix L Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
Decision 5 second time penalty 2 penalty points (total of 7 for the 12 month period).

title: Offence - Car 4 - Collision with car 16
text:
No / Driver 4 - Lando Norris
Fact Causing a collision
Offence Breach of Appendix L Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
Decision 5 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 3 for the 12 month period).

title: Offence - Car 22 - Causing a collision
text:
No / Driver 22 - Yuki Tsunoda
Fact Collision with car 10 at turn 3.
Offence Breach of Article 2 d) Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.
Decision 5 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 8 for the 12 month period).

title: Decision - Car 24 - Allegedly leaving the track and gaining an advantage
text:
No / Driver 24 - Zhou Guanyu
Fact Allegedly left the track and gained an advantage in turn 14.
Offence Alleged breach of Article 2 c) Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.
Decision No further action.

title: Offence - Car 20 - Leaving the track and gaining an advantage
text:
No / Driver 20 - Kevin Magnussen
Fact Left the track and gained an advantage in T2.
Offence Breach of Article 2 c) Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.
Decision 5 Second Time Penalty. 1 penalty point (total of 3 for the 12 month period).

title: Offence - Car 10 - Leaving the track and gaining an advantage
text:
No / Driver 10 - Pierre Gasly
Fact Leaving the track and gaining an advantage
Offence Breach of Appendix L Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
Decision 5 second time penalty 1 penalty point (total of 10 for the 12 month period).

title: Offence - Car 11 - Impeding car 63 in turn 18
text:
No / Driver 11 - Sergio Perez
Fact Unnecessary impeding of Car 63 by Car 11 at turn 18.
Offence Breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
Decision Formal Warning for the driver. A fine of €10,000 is imposed of the Competitor.

title: Decision - Car 23 - Alleged impeding of Car 55 at turn 2
text:
No / Driver 23 - Alexander Albon

text:

title: Decision - Car 31 - Allegedly ignoring yellow flags
text:
No / Driver 31 - Esteban Ocon
Fact Overtook car 47 between T11 and T12 under yellow flags.
Offence Alleged breach of Article 2.5.5 b), Appendix H of the International Sporting Code.
Decision No further action.

title: Decision - Car 18 - Alleged failing to slow under Yellow Flags
text:
No / Driver 18 - Lance Stroll
Fact Car 18 appeared not to slow for a single waved yellow flag in Turn 5.
Offence Alleged breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 b) of the International Sporting Code.
Decision No further action.

text:

title: Infringement - Car 14 False start - Moving before signal
text:
No / Driver 14 - Fernando Alonso
Fact Car 14 moved forward from its start position, prior to the start signal.
